name: Outreach CRM — Daily Follow-Up Reminder
description: Runs every weekday morning. Reads Google Sheets for leads due for follow-up today and sends you a summary digest — does NOT send emails on your behalf.

nodes.name: Schedule: 8am Mon–Fri
nodes.notes: Fires at 8am every weekday. Adjust timezone in n8n settings.

nodes.name: Anything Due Today?
nodes.notes: Only sends the email if there is at least one action due. No email = no noise.

nodes.name: Email Digest to Yourself
nodes.notes: Sends to your own inbox — not to leads. This is a reminder tool only.

nodes.name: No Actions Today — Skip
nodes.notes: If nothing is due, the workflow ends silently. No email, no noise.

meta.note: This workflow is a reminder tool only. It reads your CRM and emails YOU a digest. It does not send any outreach emails to leads. All outreach is done manually by you.
